sentences.text: A retrospective cohort study examined 209 patients who underwent fetoscopic myelomeningocele repair between 2014 and 2026, dividing them into groups based on whether their preoperative body mass index was 35 kg/m2 or higher.

The proportion of babies born before 37 weeks of gestation was similar in the high body mass index group (52%) and the lower body mass index group (49%), with average gestational ages of 35.9 and 37.0 weeks, respectively.
After adjusting for other factors, a preoperative body mass index of 35 kg/m2 or higher was not associated with preterm birth.
